jobs.title: Credit Cards Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Management Permanent ID: 102331

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Credit Card Portfolio Manager will be responsible for managing the performance, growth, and profitability of the bank’s credit card portfolio, with a strategic focus on developing and driving instalment plan products. This includes lifecycle management, customer engagement, pricing strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to enhance product uptake and usage

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Portfolio Strategy & Growth**

Develop and execute strategies to grow the credit card portfolio through instalment plan offerings (e.g., Cash on Card, EPP or post-purchase conversions including statement balances).

Analyze customer behavior and transaction data to identify opportunities for instalment plan adoption- especially through building strong propensity models

Monitor portfolio KPIs including activation, usage, balances, and profitability.

**Instalment Plan Development**

Design and launch new instalment products tailored to customer segments and merchant partnerships.

Collaborate with product, risk, and technology teams to ensure seamless customer experience and operational efficiency.

Optimize pricing, tenures, and merchant discount rates to drive uptake across channels including telesales and digital establishing excellence in offering across the industry

**Risk & Compliance**

Work closely with credit risk teams to ensure instalment plans are aligned with underwriting policies and regulatory guidelines.

Monitor delinquency trends and implement proactive risk mitigation strategies.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing**

Partner with marketing and analytics teams to develop targeted campaigns promoting instalment plans.

Drive digital adoption through app-based and online instalment conversion journeys.

**Stakeholder Management**

Liaise with internal stakeholders including finance, operations, legal, and compliance to ensure product success.

Manage relationships with external partners such as merchants, networks

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics or related field; MBA preferred.

5+ years of experience in credit card portfolio management or consumer lending.

Strong understanding of instalment lending, credit risk, and customer lifecycle management.

Analytical mindset with proficiency in data tools (Excel, SQL, SAS, etc.).

Excellent communication and project management skills.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Role summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Finance & Accounts Executive to support finance and administration across all companies in the group. The role covers bookkeeping, financial reporting, compliance, payments and receivables, budgeting, and administrative visa processing.

Key responsibilities

Group accounts and bookkeeping

* Maintain accurate books and supporting records for all group companies
* Record and reconcile income, expenses, bank transactions, journals, and intercompany balances.
* Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records, including B2B transactions.
* Manage cheque preparation, tracking, issuance, and records in line with company procedures.
* Process and track coach payments, ensuring supporting documents and approvals are in place.

Financial reporting and planning

* Prepare organisation-wise profit and loss reports and balance sheets.
* Track revenue forecasts against actuals and prepare regular variance reports.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of financial models, budgets, and cash-flow forecasts.
* Provide timely financial information to management to support planning and decision-making.
* Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

Tax and compliance

* Support tax filings and related records, including UAE VAT and Singapore GST.
* Maintain compliance calendars and organise documents needed for filings, audits, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, tax advisers, and relevant authorities as required.
* Keep financial records organised and ready for review.

Administration

* Coordinate visa processing from an administrative perspective, including document collection, application tracking, renewals, and status updates.
* Maintain finance and administration files, ensuring records are complete, current, and accessible to authorised colleagues.
* Provide general administrative support related to finance operations across the group.

Requirements

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience in bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with VAT and GST processes; experience supporting multiple entities is an advantage.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets and accounting software.
* Strong attention to detail, organisation, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage confidential information and meet reporting deadlines.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate with colleagues and external service providers.

Success in this role

Success means maintaining accurate and up-to-date books across the group, delivering dependable organisation-wise reporting, tracking forecast performance, and keeping payments, compliance records, and visa administration on schedule.

Pay: From AED3,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
